message: Preregistered a new continuous demo rather than rewriting the completed CR-DEMO-0002 runner. The new protocol prefills model caches once, streams frames over SSE and treats input as latest complete held-key state.

After the same A10 recovered from temporary inventory suspension, the frozen continuous demo source loaded final_only-medium and started protocol continuous-sse-v1. The original CR-DEMO-0002 runner remained byte-identical.
The local launchd SSH tunnel passed continuous health, three autonomous no-op frames, two held-right frames, release back to no-op, pause and reset. Stable generated-frame latency was 21.6–25.4 ms.
At 1440x900 the complete 720x720 stage and control sidebar fit in the initial viewport with no document scroll; the live page reported 46.28 FPS.

Remote verification independently passed continuous no-op advancement, held-right persistence, release, pause and reset with 21.6–25.3 ms steady latency. The runtime/layout hypothesis is supported at smoke-test level; visual coherence and learned action quality remain rejected by CR-DEMO-0002 and unclaimed here.
